original_review: Built-in tool output visibly inspected at generation; originals copied without resave.

method.sheet_display: 40px and 80px icons are pasted at exactly native pixel dimensions, not enlarged.

observations.whole_square: One centered frontal grey face with heavy ridged brows, amber-brown eyes, broad nose and downturned mouth. Swept brown crown, pointed beard, layered fur and sparse moss accents follow the supplied concept. Complete crown and beard are visible; outer shoulders and chest continue beyond the bottom/side frame as expected for a bust.
observations.full100_circle: Whole crown, ears/upper mane and pointed beard stay within the full-square centered circle. The circle trims outer lower shoulder fur and chest; no claim that every shoulder strand survives. No pan or zoom used.
observations.native_80: Grey facial mass, heavy brow, nose, downturned mouth and beard remain readable. Small amber eyes are visible as tiny dark/light points; fine iris, grey-skin wrinkles and fur-strand details are not reliable at this size. Moss is subtle.
observations.native_40: The brow/grey face, brown mane and beard remain identifiable. Individual eyes/irises are weak and should not be relied on for expression or direction at 40px; identity mainly comes from silhouette and face-to-fur contrast. Fine moss and strand detail merge.
observations.grayscale_320: Grey skin separates from the dark eye sockets and brown-fur luminance sufficiently to retain the face. Brown-versus-moss hue distinction is reduced.
limitations: Generated crown starts about 10% down, closer to the top than the requested 18%; it remains complete with visible charcoal margin and fits full100.
Outer shoulder silhouette reaches square edges and is clipped by the circle at the lower perimeter; head identity is retained.
The background is plain charcoal with a slight studio luminance variation, not verified perfectly uniform.
Native40 individual eye readability is limited; future runtime needs separate review. No zoom crop is prescribed or accepted here.
observations.recommendation: Keep g1 as source candidate for independent review, with native40 eye-detail limitation.

generation_budget.note: No actual clipped-head or identity defect found; no correction call permitted for other refinements.

acceptance: No portrait runtime acceptance, asset import or model-stage advancement is made.
